sources.title: Gemini Trifecta vulnerabilities made the Gemini AI assistant steal data ...
sources.snippet: Researchers have disclosed details of three already-fixed vulnerabilities in Google's Gemini AI assistant, collectively dubbed Gemini Trifecta. If successfully exploited, these issues allowed attackers to trick the AI into participating in data theft and other malicious activity.
